byPath.*: Plans a delivery shift: rules decide which courier may carry which parcel, and a MILP optimisation assigns the parcels within capacity and shift time
byPath.Candidates: Every parcel and courier pair, and the eligible pairs
byPath.Courier: A courier: vehicle, capacity in kilograms, minutes in the shift and the zones served
byPath.Dispatch: The optimised plan, the diagnosis when no plan exists, the route of every courier and the unassigned parcels
byPath.Pair: One parcel and one courier: whether the courier may carry it, why not, the stop time, the cost and the value
byPath.Parcel: A parcel: delivery zone, weight, priority and the cold-chain flag
byPath.ParcelFacts: Whether the parcel is express, and the value of delivering it
byPath.Shift: A delivery shift: the parcels to deliver and the couriers on duty
byPath.ShiftFacts: The number of parcels, couriers and express parcels, and the total weight
byPath.candidatePair: The fit, the stop time, the cost and the value of one parcel with one courier
byPath.courierFit: Whether a courier may carry a parcel: zone, cold chain and bike weight
byPath.dispatchPlan: The assignment of parcels to couriers with the largest value: each parcel at most once, every express parcel delivered, within capacity and time
byPath.dispatchPolicy: The parameters of the dispatch policy: the delivery values, the bike weight limit and the cost per minute
byPath.morningBook: A morning shift of 14 parcels for a bike, a van and a cold van
byPath.peakBook: A peak day with more express parcels than the cold van can deliver
byPath.peakBook.plan: The dispatch plan, with the diagnosis of the solver
byPath.planShift: Plans a shift and returns the routes, the unassigned parcels with reasons and a summary
byPath.stopCost: The fixed cost of one stop by vehicle
byPath.stopMinutes: The minutes of one stop by vehicle and zone
